title: 第1215章 勃勃生机万物竞发第1214章 天仙大宗落地生根
slug: 炼气家族我有一个造化空间
lines: 只见十绝仙子抬手，天仙大阵运转起来。
此阵在她的掌控下，犹如一尊天仙大能施展神通法术，拥有改天换地之能。
天仙大阵，在天仙手中是杀阵，也是造化之阵。
大阵之力可改天换地、可移山填海、可凭空造物。
这便是天仙级别阵法的恐怖之处，它不仅仅是一座防御大阵，更是一件能与天地共鸣的无上法宝。
她的声音，传遍四方：
“此阵名曰·大弥天阵，为天仙中品阵法。”
天仙中品阵法，这六个字的分量，足以让任何天仙初期为之侧目。
天仙阵法分下品、中品、上品、极品四个层次。
下品阵法足以困杀天仙初期，中品阵法可战天仙中期，上品阵法可抗天仙后期，极品阵法便是天仙巅峰也要忌惮三分。
大弥天阵，天仙中品，意味着这座大阵全力运转之下，天仙中期大能也难以攻破。
而掌控此阵的十绝仙子，以真仙中期修为驾驭天仙中品阵法，其实际战力，已不弱于天仙中期。
轰！
她炼化阵盘、驾驭阵旗、执掌大阵、掌控天仙洞府，轻声开口：“本座说，此地应有洞天洞府，承载造化仙宗传承。”
“太上长老仙府，起！”
轰隆隆！
四阶巅峰仙脉之上，最核心的区域，一座巍峨洞府拔地而起，借助天仙大阵之力和阵法之主的操控，凭空造物。
大阵之力化作千万道法则之链，交织缠绕，在虚空中勾勒出一座洞府的轮廓.
那轮廓越来越清晰、越来越凝实，最终从虚化实，一座实实在在的太上长老仙府矗立于四阶巅峰仙脉之巅。
原本废弃的、古老的、残缺的天仙洞府得到天仙大阵之力修建、修补，在数以万计的修士眼中拔地而起。
那些原本坍塌的洞壁被阵法之力重新砌筑，那些破碎的禁制被阵法之力重新编织，那些干涸的灵泉被阵法之力重新激活。
残破万古的天仙洞府，在大弥天阵的运转下，如同枯木逢春，焕发出崭新的生机。
十几条仙品灵脉，辐射方圆上百万里，有仙脉平原、药谷兽域、分洞通道……天仙大阵之下衍生各个区域阵法，诸如：
云雾大阵、幻阵、五行大阵、九宫封界，隔绝凡俗浊气，锁住仙脉之气不外溢。
一层层阵法如同天罗地网，将方圆百万里笼罩其中。
云雾大阵遮蔽外界窥探，幻阵迷惑闯入者，五行大阵稳固仙脉根基，九宫封界隔绝内外。
四阵合一，方圆百万里便成了一座铁桶般的独立天地。
方圆百万里区域，是造化仙宗内宗，属于仙品灵脉区域，最低也得大乘道尊修为方可开辟洞府。
十绝仙子再抬手：“宗主仙府，起！”
太上长老仙府之下，一座宗主仙府拔地而起，这是造化仙宗之主·第一御极的修炼之所和居住之地。
宗主仙府虽不及太上长老仙府那般占据四阶仙脉最核心区域，却也坐落在四阶仙脉的次核心地带，仙气浓郁程度只比太上长老仙府低一线。
“脉主仙府，起！”
轰！轰轰轰
四大脉主洞府，也耸立于四阶巅峰灵脉区域，仍旧属于天仙级别洞府，只不过是堪堪达到天仙下品。
但对于真仙境、甚至是仙域境的修士而言，已是难得的仙缘。
天仙下品洞府，放在雷部二十四域之中，也只有在天仙宗门之内才能享有。
content_en:
I saw Shijue Fairy raising her hand, and the Celestial Immortal Formation began to move.
Under her control, this formation is like a powerful celestial being who can cast supernatural powers and spells, possessing the ability to change the world.
The Celestial Immortal Formation, in the hands of the Celestial Immortal, is both a killing formation and a creation formation.
The power of the great formation can change the world, move mountains and fill seas, and create things out of thin air.
This is the terrifying thing about the immortal-level formation. It is not only a defensive formation, but also a supreme magic weapon that can resonate with heaven and earth.
Her voice spread everywhere:
"The name of this formation is the Great Heaven Formation, and it is a middle-level formation of the Heavenly Immortal."
The weight of these six words is enough to make any early-stage Celestial Immortal look askance at the middle-grade Celestial Immortal Formation.
The Heavenly Immortal Formation is divided into four levels: low-grade, medium-grade, high-grade, and top-grade.
The low-grade formations are enough to trap and kill the early-stage immortals, the middle-grade formations can fight against the mid-stage immortals, the high-grade formations can resist the late-stage immortals, and the top-grade formations are afraid of even the peak immortals.
The Great Heavenly Formation is a middle-grade Heavenly Immortal Formation, which means that even if this great formation is operating at full strength, it will be difficult to break through even a mid-level Heavenly Immortal Formation.
The Shijue Fairy who controls this formation has mastered the mid-level Celestial Immortal Formation with a mid-level True Immortal cultivation level, and its actual combat power is no longer weaker than that of a mid-level Celestial Immortal.
boom!
She refined the formation plate, controlled the formation flag, commanded the great formation, and controlled the Celestial Immortal Cave. She spoke softly: "I said that this place should have a Cave of Cave to carry the inheritance of the Good Fortune Immortal Sect."
"The Supreme Elder's Immortal Mansion, get up!"
Boom!
Above the fourth-level peak immortal veins, in the core area, a majestic cave mansion rises from the ground. With the help of the power of the immortal formation and the control of the formation master, creations are created out of thin air.
The power of the great formation turned into thousands of chains of laws, intertwined and entwined, and outlined the outline of a cave in the void.
The outline became clearer and more solid, and finally turned into reality. A real Supreme Elder's Immortal Mansion stood at the top of the fourth-level peak Immortal Veins.
The originally abandoned, ancient, and incomplete Tianxian Cave was built and repaired by the power of the Tianxian Formation, and it sprung up in the eyes of tens of thousands of monks.
Those cave walls that originally collapsed were rebuilt by the power of the formation, those broken restrictions were rewoven by the power of the formation, and those dry spiritual springs were reactivated by the power of the formation.
The eternally dilapidated Tianxian Cave Mansion, under the operation of the Great Heaven Formation, is like a dead tree blooming with new vitality.
More than a dozen immortal spiritual veins radiate in a radius of millions of miles, including the Immortal Vein Plain, the Medicine Valley Beast Realm, the Branch Cave Passage... Various regional formations are derived from the Celestial Immortal Formation, such as:
The cloud and mist formation, the illusion formation, the five elements formation, and the nine palaces seal the boundaries, which isolate the mundane and turbid air and lock the immortal energy from leaking out.
The layers of formations are like a dragnet, covering a million miles in radius.
The cloud and mist formation blocks outside prying eyes, the illusion formation confuses intruders, the Five Elements formation stabilizes the foundation of the immortal veins, and the nine palaces seal the boundary to isolate the inside and outside.
When the four formations merge into one, a million miles in radius becomes an independent world like an iron barrel.
The area with a radius of one million miles is the inner sect of the Creation Immortal Sect, which belongs to the Immortal Grade Spiritual Vein Area. At least one has to be a Mahayana Taoist to open a cave.
Fairy Shijue raised her hand again: "Sect Master Immortal Mansion, get up!"
Under the Immortal Mansion of the Supreme Elder, a Sect Master Immortal Mansion rises from the ground. This is the place of cultivation and residence of the Lord of the Creation Immortal Sect, the First Yuji.
Although the Sect Master's Immortal Mansion does not occupy the core area of ​​the fourth-order Immortal Vein as much as the Supreme Elder's Immortal Mansion, it is also located in the sub-core area of ​​the fourth-order Immortal Vein. The intensity of the Immortal Qi is only slightly lower than that of the Supreme Elder's Immortal Mansion.
"Pulse Master Immortal Mansion, get up!"
Boom! Boom boom boom
The caves of the four major vein masters also stand in the fourth-level peak spiritual vein area. They are still at the level of heavenly immortals, but they are only close to the lower level of heavenly immortals.
But for monks in the True Immortal Realm or even the Immortal Realm, it is already a rare fairy fate.
The lower-grade Tianxian Cave Mansion is placed among the twenty-four regions of the Lei Department, and can only be enjoyed within the Tianxian Sect.
